purpose: Quantify how the reconstructed monthly valuation allocation behaves when implemented with actual mutual-fund NAV returns and explicit investor-level turnover-friction sensitivities.

frozen_source.note: Fund NAV returns already embed each fund's own expense ratio, portfolio-management effects and realised tracking behaviour. Pre-inception proxy months are excluded from the strict implementation audit.

comparators.primary: monthly rebalanced static allocation at the dynamic strategy's realised mean equity weight
comparators.reason: Keeps average equity exposure comparable while applying identical actual fund returns and identical turnover-friction accounting.

turnover_rule: Trade size is the absolute difference between the new target equity weight and the previous month's drifted post-return equity weight. Initial funding is not charged as rebalancing turnover.
required_outputs: dynamic and exposure-matched static max drawdown
implementation drag versus zero-friction actual-fund NAV implementation

explicitly_unmodelled.investor_tax_lots: No after-tax claim is permitted. Indian tax treatment depends on vehicle, holding period, realised lot path and investor circumstances, and historical rules changed during the sample.
explicitly_unmodelled.exit_loads: Not modelled until a dated, scheme-specific load schedule is reconstructed.
explicitly_unmodelled.ETF_bid_ask_spreads: Not applicable to the mutual-fund NAV implementation used here; any ETF implementation requires a separate observed-spread study.
explicitly_unmodelled.cash_drag_and_execution_timing: Not modelled beyond monthly NAV-to-NAV returns and the explicit turnover-friction envelope.

promotion_rule: This audit can reduce confidence or expose costs. It cannot promote or alter V3.13, its calibration, trend brake, earnings overlay or macro authority.
